planner_json.title: Show the ten keyed cells' four grades and their identity from the finished run
depends_on: GAW-1 (the checks evidence_paths schema field the recorder validates)

write_prohibited: .github/workflows/harness-eval.yml - no workflow change in this task
.spec/e2e-policy/** - the two policy files are committed with the plan
test/harness/adapters/** - GAW-1 and the adapter tasks own them
test/harness/smoke/** - GAW-1, E1, E2, E3 and E9 own them
Any file not listed in WRITE-ALLOWED

seed/hosted-dispatch.description: The newest completed harness-eval run on the landed commit, started by a real dispatch

specification.objective: A finished hand dispatch shows twelve cells, with four evidenced checks and a proven identity on each of the ten keyed cells, and the recorder refuses a graded pass that cites nothing.
specification.success_state: On the newest completed run for HEAD, 40 check rows cite evidence, requested equals observed on 10 of 10 keyed cells, `plugin_revision` equals `candidate_sha`, both cursor cells read could-not-run `missing-api-key`, and the summary carries one row per check. A pass check with blank `evidence_paths` is refused with `check-unevidenced`.

requirements.description: GIVEN a real hand dispatch finished on the landed commit WHEN the flow resolves the newest completed harness-eval run whose `head_sha` equals `git rev-parse HEAD`, downloads its attempt-qualified result, and reads `grade/harness-eval-result.json` and `recorder.log` THEN `.cells | length` prints 12 across 6 harnesses, 40 check rows on the ten keyed cells cite evidence, requested equals observed on 10 of 10 keyed cells with `plugin_revision` equal to `candidate_sha`, both cursor cells read `could-not-run` `missing-api-key`, and `recorder.log` prints `files-and-event-stream` on 40 rows
requirements.verification_service: GitHub Actions harness-eval run on hackerpug-ai/pixel-perfect, read through gh and its harness-eval-result artifact
requirements.positive_example: A run on the landed commit where 40 check rows on the ten keyed cells cite evidence, requested equals observed on all ten, and both cursor cells read could-not-run missing-api-key.
requirements.red: Run 41157270388's artifact: 0 of 40 check rows cite evidence, 32 read adapter-not-implemented, and requested equals observed on 1 of 10 keyed cells.

scenario.verification_service: GitHub Actions harness-eval run on hackerpug-ai/pixel-perfect, read through gh and its harness-eval-result artifact

would_fail_if: a keyed cell omits a check, or a check carries an empty evidence_paths array
a newest cell is stamped with the pin instead of the version that track resolved
the recorder is disconnected, so the artifact is absent or static

examples: jq prints 40 for checks with evidence paths

build_proof.range: anything that proves a real dispatch produced twelve cells whose ten keyed cells each carry four evidenced checks bound to the version and plugin they ran

steps: gh run download the newest completed run's harness-eval-result-<RUN_ID>-<attempt> artifact for this commit
read grade/harness-eval-result.json and recorder.log from it

must_observe: 40 check rows on the ten keyed cells carry a non-empty evidence_paths array
requested_cli_version equals observed_cli_version on 10 of 10 keyed cells, and plugin_revision equals candidate_sha
both cursor cells read `could-not-run` with reason `missing-api-key`
must_not_observe: a keyed cell with an empty checks array or 0 evidence paths
a screenshot score, pixel percentage, or image-diff field in any cell
a pass taken from process_exit_code 0 alone

requirements.description: GIVEN the downloaded result with one pass check's `evidence_paths` blanked WHEN those cells pass through `collectCells` THEN it throws `RecorderRefusal` with reason `check-unevidenced`, and no result file is written
requirements.verification_service: real recorder module and shipped schema over a real downloaded result
requirements.positive_example: The real result unchanged is accepted; the same result with one pass check's evidence_paths blanked is refused.
requirements.red: On base toHarnessCell accepts a pass check with no evidence_paths, so collectCells does not throw and this test fails.

scenario.verification_service: real recorder module and shipped schema over a real downloaded result

would_fail_if: the recorder validation is a no-op, so a keyed pass with empty evidence_paths is recorded

build_proof.range: anything that proves the recorder refuses a graded pass check with no evidence path

steps: take the downloaded result, blank one pass check's evidence_paths, and feed the cells to collectCells

must_not_observe: a result file written with 0 evidence paths on a pass check
